queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Government of Bihar Revenue and Land Reforms Department, Directorate of Land Records & Survey, and the public BhuNaksha Bihar cadastral viewer. Official BhuNaksha hierarchy requests exposed East Champaran/Pakri Dayal/Patahi and a Patahi Jadu mauza, but no parcel geometry for the exact WUP point.

officialSources.observation: Official Government of Bihar/NIC BhuNaksha Bihar cadastral mapping viewer. Current HTML and JavaScript were inspected; the public route exposes location hierarchy, map-instance counts, WMS configuration, and REST endpoints without login for the viewer.
Official Bihar Revenue and Land Reforms Department landing page naming Bhu-Manchitra/Bhu-Naksha, the Directorate of Land Records and Survey, and revenue-map services.

The viewer also exposed the Patahi administrative/mauza hierarchy, but citywide parcel coverage was not established.
